text:
beth: quick thread - finalizing SDK retry+pagination semantics across py/ts/go. goal: identical high-level iterator behavior, clear transport negotiation, and safe idempotency for page retries.

kevin: +1. checklist: (1) resume token opaqueness + stability, (2) per-page idempotency tokens for safe replay, (3) backoff defaults with jitter, (4) transport negotiation header so clients know if server will push prefetch/stream hints.

lisa: for resume tokens we keep them opaque but require they include a server-side monotonic offset internally. client must never parse. server promises token validity across minor model version changes. on invalid token return structured error.

omar: error shape suggestion for stale/bad resume: `HTTP 409` or grpc code `FAILED_PRECONDITION` with payload {"error":"stale_resume","resume_token":"...","recommended_backoff_ms":200}. SDKs should auto-retry with provided resume_token up to 3 attempts before surfacing.

beth: agree. also add per-page idempotency token header so that a retried POST/Generate call doesn't produce duplicate work when the server already processed it but before client got response. header name proposal: `x-rw-idempotency-token`. SDKs auto-generate UUID v4 per logical page request.

kevin: backoff policy: full-jitter per AWS paper. base = 100ms, cap = 2000ms, attempts cap = 5. language runtimes should default to this but expose config. include an opt-in `aggressive_retries` flag for infra/hardless apps.

lisa: about transport negotiation: header `x-rw-transport: stream=1,prefetch=1,ver=1`. server sets it on capabilities endpoints/responses. if stream=1 clients may open an opt-in control stream (Session) to receive prefetch hints and resume-token invalidation. if header missing, fall back to unary-only behavior. this prevents double-prefetch with older servers.

omar: iterator ergonomics across langs: SDKs provide high-level iterator that hides resume/retry logic. examples:

// python
for page in client.list_messages(req):
    for m in page.items:
        handle(m)

// ts
for await (const page of client.listMessages(req)) {
  page.items.forEach(x => handle(x))
}

// go
it := client.ListMessages(ctx, req)
for it.Next() {
  item := it.Value()
}

by default the iterator: retries transient network errors, handles `stale_resume` by using returned resume_token and resumes, dedupes items from partial pages using server-provided sequence numbers. expose hooks: `on_retry` and `on_resume` for advanced users.

beth: dedupe approach: server includes `x-rw-page-range: start=123,end=246` (monotonic positions) inside the page payload metadata. SDK dedupes by tracking last seen position per iterator. avoids application-level duplicates without exposing internals.

kevin: billing/accounting with speculative prefetch: speculative work should only be billed if model produced tokens delivered to client. server will tag traces with `prefetch_speculative=true` and provide `speculative_consumed_tokens` counters in telemetry. SDKs surface telemetry to users.

lisa: compatibility note: older SDKs that do naive client prefetch must detect capability header and stop when `x-rw-transport` indicates server prefetch. fallback handshake: server may set `x-rw-transport: prefetch_handled=1` on responses so clients skip local prefetch for that request.

omar: security/ratelimiting: per-idempotency-token rate limits apply. servers reject duplicate idempotency tokens older than TTL with `409`+`existing_result` pointer. SDKs should retry with new token if they detect TTL expiry.

tai: tests: add matrix for combinations: old-sdk+new-server, new-sdk+old-server, stream-enabled/disabled, network blips with injected `stale_resume` errors, and idempotency token collisions. include a fuzz test that reorders page fragments to ensure dedupe logic holds.

ops-bot: infra-bot: created issue INFR-3301: "sdk-retry-pagination-idempotency-transport-negotiation" assigned to @beth.

beth: next steps - i'll draft RFC w/ header names, error shapes, backoff knobs, and iterator hook API examples. @lisa please spec page metadata fields, @kevin please write backoff library example for go/py/ts, @omar add e2e test cases.

lisa: will add the `x-rw-page-range` and page metadata format to the RFC.

kevin: i'll prototype a tiny backoff util in the mono-repo we can vendor into SDKs.

omar: test matrix + harness incoming. will ping for review.

beth: thanks everyone. closing thread; will link RFC in #eng-arch once draft is ready. :tada:
